scope: Bounded evidence maintenance after underside manufacturing repair; this is an informed rereview, not a new blind review or redesign round.

observations: Refreshed isometric and signature images retain the broad thin fixed base, nested annular and disk carriers, abstract counters, recesses and stacked counters. No visible form regression is apparent at the presented scale.

The outer-right stack moves to an inner-right final stack; other selected counters change radial lanes and angular positions while unselected counters remain seated during transfer. The specific carrier-to-carrier transfer resolved in round 2 remains visible.

Pale surfaces and small marks remain a legibility limitation. No new blocking visual defect is visible. The underside taper difference is too small and insufficiently exposed to measure from these images.
limitations: The animation illustrates hand handling rather than self-actuation. It does not prove printed fit, friction, stability, strength, manufacturability or human gameplay quality. It shows the physical rotation and selective transfer sequence, not a complete visual demonstration of secret selection and scoring rules. The reported taper angle, dimensions and manufacturing checks require separate CAD and deterministic evidence.
resolution: Retain the round-2 visual verdict for these refreshed image bytes. Preserve the original blind review and both prior revealed review records.
